name: SpiderWeb
summary: Australian ISP operating on spiderweb.com.au from Dec 1998 into the 2000s (also served from www2.spiderweb.com.au); ~1,000+ Wayback captures attest to an active, long-lived provider.

events.details: Earliest Wayback capture of spiderweb.com.au 12 Dec 1998; site active throughout the late 1990s-2000s.

PENDING birth-date research. Current 'by' date needs upgrading.
